description: The interface is served by the bundled Phoenix server over loopback, so the webview's origin is http://127.0.0.1:<port> rather than the tauri:// scheme. Tauri treats that as a remote origin and rejects every IPC call from it unless a capability names the origin. The open and save pickers, interface zoom command, window theme, and slim title bar controls are granted; the app talks to Elixir over the same loopback connection for everything else.
